name: BEDI
recent: BEDI 于 2026 年 10 月 31 日完成以约 RM38.87 million 向关联方 BEDI Development 收购 Sejati Sentral (Sandakan) 与 FYT Land (KK) 全部股权，该交易已在 9 月 28 日 EGM 获股东通过。同期，公司以 RM14.30 million 出售 Kota Kinabalu 的仓库与办公楼，并于 9 月 22 日视为完成。最新季度（截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日）业绩已公布。
notable: 完成以约 RM38.87 million 向 BEDI Development 收购 Sejati Sentral (Sandakan) 与 FYT Land (KK) 全部股权。
以 RM14.30 million 出售位于 Kota Kinabalu 的 49,920 平方英尺土地连同两座仓库及一栋办公楼，已于 2026 年 9 月 22 日视为完成。
2026 年 9 月 28 日召开第 11 届 AGM 及 EGM，所有决议案均获股东通过。
risks: 收购 Sejati Sentral 与 FYT Land 属关联方交易，卖方为 BEDI Development Sdn. Bhd.。
出售 Kota Kinabalu 产业涉及非关联方交易，交易金额 RM14.30 million。

news.title: BEDI completes RM14.3m sale of Kota Kinabalu commercial property
BEDI seeks nod for RM38.87m Sabah acquisitions with RM1.13b remaining GDV

recent_en: BEDI completed the acquisitions of the entire equity interests in Sejati Sentral (Sandakan) and FYT Land (KK) from related party BEDI Development for approximately RM38.87 million on 31 October 2026, after shareholders approved the deals at the EGM on 28 September. In parallel, the company disposed of warehouses and an office block in Kota Kinabalu for RM14.30 million, deemed completed on 22 September. The latest quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 were announced.
notable_en: Completed the acquisitions of the entire equity interests in Sejati Sentral (Sandakan) and FYT Land (KK) from BEDI Development for approximately RM38.87 million.
Disposed of a 49,920 sq ft parcel of land with two warehouses and an office block in Kota Kinabalu for RM14.30 million, deemed completed on 22 September 2026.
Held the 11th AGM and EGM on 28 September 2026; all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
risks_en: The acquisitions of Sejati Sentral and FYT Land are related party transactions with seller BEDI Development Sdn. Bhd.
The disposal of the Kota Kinabalu property is a non-related party transaction valued at RM14.30 million.
